ctx.x: And then in the trumpet section, they had Conrad Gozzo and Harry James and I think Charlie Shavers was in that trumpet section. Of course, the original
Benny Goodman trumpet section would have been, in the heyday (Gordon) would have been Harry James, Ziggy Elman and Chris Griffin.
